notes.title: H.I.A. is going Free to Play!
notes.content:
Hi everybody,

We are officially turning the H.I.A. into a Free to Play game!

The H.I.A. is a fun and short gameplay experience and therefore it would fit the game better if it were Free to Play.

This way more people can try it out!

We've created a ticket to Steam to change the game into Free to Play. As soon as that gets accepted it will be Free to Play.

Hopefully within a week. 

Cheers,

The Developer

notes.title: Official Early Access Release! We are live!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2363590/extras/HIA_Gameplay.gif?t=1691265590[/img]

[h1]Hey guys![/h1]

[h3]Rob & Wim here, the developers.[/h3]

We just wanted to let you know that our game is [b]now live[/b] and that we appreciate anyone checking it out! 

We are two brothers who set out to make a fun horror game, which we can all enjoy with friends.

We are working on a lot of [b]features/content[/b] and would appreciate your feedback.

Join our [url=https://discord.gg/KfVEGKtrkG]Discord[/url] to let us know what you think.

[b][i]Here is a little overview of what we aim to add[/i][/b]
in the next few months:

• More missions and gameplay features
• More monsters
• More maps
• More character customization options
• More emotes, gestures and other fun social features
• More equipment: Melee weapons, More flashlights, Medkits, 
  Bandages, Tools
• Leveling system: XP, Level Up
• Reward system: Earn money by playing missions, spend that 
  money on fun things (Player customization, Lobby customization)

Thanks for joining us!

[h3]We make rapid updates and iterations to the game on a weekly basis, so be on the lookout.[/h3]

Rob & Wim
© Kekdot 2023

[i]PS: If there’s bugs please report them to us lol[/i]
